prediction_metrics.primary_metric_rationale: For retention/admission decisions, failing to retain a future-requested expert causes a miss; recall over future requested experts directly measures coverage of needed items. It avoids misleading scalar accuracy on sparse top-k sets and is compatible with per-layer next-step targets. Precision/Jaccard/F1/ranking/byte-weighted variants remain diagnostic because over-prediction has cache-pressure costs evaluated in R2-11 retention metrics.

metrics.name: Ranking metric (NDCG/MAP) if scores output
metrics.condition: only when predictor outputs ranked scores/lists

metrics.name: Byte-weighted recall (optional)
metrics.rationale: Expert objects have heterogeneous byte sizes; byte-weighted variant may be reported as diagnostic.

prediction_metrics.reporting: Report per workload family and per (M,W_class) context where applicable; do not report only global aggregates for confirmatory claims.

metrics.note: Continuity view where useful; preserve comparator/context semantics.

metrics.definition: (B-P)/(B-O_B); signed, may be negative or >1 under CASE C; >1 means beats O_B not O*; not fraction of maximum causal opportunity.
